description:
Santa Fe photographer Tyler Dingee was a member of the Architectural Photographers Association of America and perhaps best known for his pictures of buildings. But his talents had extended into every field of camera art, from sports, to portraiture, to landscapes, to industrial photography, before a bolt of lightning cut short his career last week. THE PALACE STAMP picture. The first photograph ever used on a United States stamp was this Dingee. When some examples of his work in these various fields were exhibited at the Museum of New Mexico art gallery in 1956, critic Dyke Van Remooler placed his photographs on par with those of Edward Stiechen, Ansel Adams and Alfred Stieglitz, the three most famous names in American photography.
